standard_prerequisites: the localization morphism of ringed sites epsilon from the small etale site of X to its Zariski site, and the stalk formula for epsilon^*F at a geometric point

flatness of a morphism of ringed sites checked on stalks (Modules on Sites, Lemma sites-modules-lemma-check-flat-stalks), the point morphism of sites (Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-point-morphism-sites) and enough points (Etale Cohomology, Remarks etale-cohomology-remarks-enough-points)
the etale local ring O_{etale, xbar} is the strict henselization of O_{X,x} (Etale Cohomology, Lemma etale-cohomology-lemma-describe-etale-local-ring)
faithful flatness of the strict henselization over the local ring (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-dumb-properties-henselization)
flat pullback of modules is exact (Modules on Sites, Lemma sites-modules-lemma-flat-pullback-exact)
core_obligations: Prove that epsilon is a flat morphism of ringed sites, that epsilon^* is exact, and that epsilon^*F = 0 implies F = 0
proof_roadmap: Flatness is checked on stalks: for every geometric point the map O_{X,x} -> O_{etale,xbar} must be flat; the etale local ring is the strict henselization of O_{X,x} and henselizations are faithfully flat, so epsilon is flat (an alternative is quoted from Descent).
Exactness of epsilon^* on modules follows from flatness of epsilon by the standard lemma of Modules on Sites.

If epsilon^*F = 0, then the stalk F_x tensor O_{etale,xbar} vanishes for every geometric point by the stalk formula; faithful flatness of O_{X,x} -> O_{etale,xbar} forces F_x = 0 for all x, hence F = 0.
difficulty_reason: H2: a three-part verification where each part is a short reduction to stalks plus a standard quoted fact about strict henselizations.
